q1_comment: Abstract is a review of prediction models and quantum-based enhancements to forecast carbon neutrality, not a description of an actual climate-neutral pathway or system configuration.
q2_comment: References 'cities worldwide' but provides no specific geographic targeting; this is a global/methodological review.
